## What M2 delivers
The operator opens Work, enters a site, direct-edits on the canvas under the latency target, undoes exactly, sees honest history, and reads a real spec. The pipeline builds a real site from a brief with total DNA capture and a recipe savable from any successful run. Deploy publishes to FAMtasticInc with a verified manifest, an explicit active-release pointer, and a rollback that switches the pointer back and re-verifies. Proofs observes read-only. Shadow runs produce comparison evidence inside a fail-closed boundary.

## Measured, not asserted
- Click-to-edit: p50 12ms, p95 23ms against a 140ms target (docs/env/latency-2026-08-22.md).
- Site denominators against real data: directories 5, valid_spec 5, customer 0, deployable 0, live 0. The zeros are honest: real specs carry no customer or deploy block.
- PROVE list: docs/env/prove-2026-08-22.md, with three defects found and fixed and one item recorded NOT-APPLICABLE rather than passed.

## Defects the gates caught that would otherwise have shipped
Two cross-site breaches (canvas path escape, pipeline retry taking its site from a run record), a symlink containment hole, a rerun that could certify itself, deploy evidence written before the bytes landed, go-live manufacturing production evidence it never checked, DNA tree identity that could not distinguish two dirty trees, a broken CTA passing verification because the verifier skipped every fragment link, Proofs laundering unreadable logs into a claim of absence, and a deployments page rendering real receipts as empty.

## Known limitation carried to the cutover
G4-1 reports three of five zero-write audit locations as SKIPPED-WITH-REASON. The outreach guarantee rests on containment, not observation. See docs/research/revenue-safety-gates-2026-08-22.md.
